scope: Ten named projects from the user's screenshot, their developed variants, other local experiment families, sixteen original proposals and eight cross-cutting focus areas. Candidate/question banks are research agendas, not separate executed experiments; this is not a claim to have adjudicated every atlas question or reread every referenced external paper.

groups.title: Experiment - Quorum of Mirrors
groups.judgment: Strong evidence-dependence question. Separate sources, voters and rounds; the useful result must beat source deduplication, not merely show that copies agree.

groups.title: Experiment - Phantom Coast
groups.judgment: PC-1 now defines a small fixed-evidence history test. Validate the instrument and stage its qualification; active exploration remains a separate question.

groups.title: Experiment - Right Dissenter
groups.judgment: Promising bounded-challenge protocol. Pair useful corrections with harmful reversals and compare against always-check and exact rules.

groups.title: Experiment - Optimal Swarm Size
groups.judgment: Careful design, oversized first programme. Establish a size-by-dependency effect before fitting a launch rule; compare against resource-only sizing.

groups.title: Research Heterogenous Swarms
groups.judgment: The biological revision is more interesting. Verify actual capability costs, partner-specific dependence and charged artifact reuse before claiming ecological mechanisms.

groups.title: Experiment - Swarm of Theseus
groups.judgment: The old result establishes supplied-procedure transmission. The stronger next test is selective continuity after acquired practices and multiple replacement waves.

groups.title: Experiment - Immune Response
groups.judgment: Damage and competence need separate measurement. Healthy success has not translated into reliable repair; the solo reference also harms a healthy control.

groups.title: Experiment - How to win agents and influence swarms
groups.judgment: Procurement is a substantial realism improvement. Freeze authorization semantics and qualify every relevant constraint before claiming peer-vote influence.

groups.title: Experiment - Healing Helping Hands
groups.judgment: Jev matches the exact extractor. Repair is largely an encoded union/update rule; add temporal revision and independent task utility before a collective-learning claim.

groups.title: Experiment - Antsy
groups.judgment: External receipts make v4 informative: neither committee beats confidence alone. Fix empty-check/estimator semantics before increasing complexity or headcount.

groups.title: Additional experiments and research designs
groups.judgment: Regrowth, Avalon, the methods toy and explanatory proposals remain part of the full project review.

areas.name: Immune response and recovery
areas.assessment: Keep containment, restoration, repair and harmless non-action separate. A healthy competence pass is not a recovery qualification. Measure immediate damage and useful post-repair work.
areas.priority: Operational immune repair or one Avalon memory mechanism; do not call an encoded repair rule emergent immunity.

areas.name: Evidence and diversity
areas.assessment: Vary evidence ancestry separately from model identity, prompts and headcount. Extra calls or privileged information can explain a heterogeneous-team gain.
areas.priority: Quorum source-dependence contrast; biological heterogeneity after actual component capability and costs are specified.

areas.name: Memory and knowledge continuity
areas.assessment: Memory usefulness is established only narrowly. Equal-information archives, reset semantics and acquired procedures are needed to distinguish copying, learning and selective forgetting.
areas.priority: Theseus selective continuity and Phantom fixed-evidence history; share memory contracts but keep their hypotheses distinct.

areas.name: Dissent and governance
areas.assessment: A successful challenge must improve decisions after accounting for harmful reversals, cost and delay. Scripted minorities do not demonstrate spontaneous dissent.
areas.priority: Right Dissenter bounded verification, with Quorum owning evidence dependence and influence owning ballot display.

areas.name: Provenance and trust
areas.assessment: Exact source IDs are useful instrument controls. Real lineage can be partial, forged or ambiguous; record evaluator ancestry without handing it to the treatment.
areas.priority: Implementable partial-lineage defenses versus an explicitly labeled oracle ceiling, after exact ancestry checks work.

areas.name: Budgets and incentives
areas.assessment: Charge all selection, verification, retries, failed work, translation and coordination. More actors is not a fixed-budget comparison. Artificial costs can manufacture an apparent ecological advantage.
areas.priority: Small sizing pilot and paid verification value; retain Commons/incentive designs as future work with explicit utility sensitivity.

areas.name: Coordination and adaptation
areas.assessment: Separate extra observations, complementary tools and topology from coordination itself. In active exploration, changed observations are a mediator to measure, not forcibly equalize.
areas.priority: One adaptive-allocation or error-correlation mechanism before population sweeps; avoid treating independently copied local games as growing coordination complexity.

areas.name: Measurement and reproducibility
areas.assessment: Freeze actual agent/context receipts, phase-specific randomness and outcome-independent scoring. Retain wrong-valid, invalid, failed and not-run assignments separately. Independent worlds/lineages determine uncertainty.
areas.priority: Implement the lightweight lifecycle contract and repair launch/validation defects from the original audit before affected runners are reused.
